clusters.name: Linear equations, functions, systems, and inequalities

standards.description: Create and solve linear equations in one variable, including equations with fractional coefficients and equations with no solution or infinitely many solutions.
standards.ccssText: Solve linear equations in one variable and interpret solutions in context; recognize when an equation has zero, one, or infinitely many solutions. (College Board: Algebra, Linear equations in one variable)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Evaluate, graph, and interpret linear functions; interpret slope and intercepts in context from equations, tables, and graphs.
standards.ccssText: Interpret and use linear functions in slope-intercept and standard form, connecting algebraic, tabular, graphical, and verbal representations. (College Board: Algebra, Linear functions)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Write, interpret, and graph linear equations in two variables from real-world and mathematical contexts, including parallel and perpendicular lines.
standards.ccssText: Create linear equations in two variables to model relationships and connect equations to their graphs. (College Board: Algebra, Linear equations in two variables)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Solve systems of two linear equations algebraically and graphically; determine the number of solutions; set up systems from word problems.
standards.ccssText: Solve systems of two linear equations in two variables and interpret solutions, including systems with no solution or infinitely many solutions. (College Board: Algebra, Systems of two linear equations in two variables)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Solve linear inequalities in one or two variables, interpret solution sets and shaded regions, and model constraints from context.
standards.ccssText: Create, solve, and interpret linear inequalities in one or two variables, including identifying points in a solution region. (College Board: Algebra, Linear inequalities in one or two variables)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Rewrite and factor polynomial and rational expressions; apply exponent rules and recognize equivalent forms of an expression.
standards.ccssText: Make connections between equivalent forms of algebraic expressions, including factoring, expanding, and rewriting with rational exponents. (College Board: Advanced Math, Equivalent expressions)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Solve quadratic equations by factoring, the quadratic formula, and completing the square; interpret vertex, roots, and discriminant; connect to parabola graphs.
standards.ccssText: Solve and interpret quadratic equations and functions in one and two variables, including vertex form and the number of real solutions. (College Board: Advanced Math, Nonlinear equations and functions)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Model growth and decay with exponential functions; interpret initial value and growth factor; distinguish linear from exponential change.
standards.ccssText: Create and interpret exponential functions that model real-world growth and decay, including percent change per period. (College Board: Advanced Math, Nonlinear functions)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Solve polynomial, radical, and rational equations; check for extraneous solutions; use zeros and factors of polynomials.
standards.ccssText: Solve equations involving radicals, rational expressions, and higher-degree polynomials, identifying extraneous solutions where they arise. (College Board: Advanced Math, Nonlinear equations in one variable)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Solve systems mixing linear and nonlinear equations; use function notation, composition of values, and graph transformations.
standards.ccssText: Solve systems of one linear and one nonlinear equation and work fluently with function notation and transformations of graphs. (College Board: Advanced Math, Systems of equations in two variables)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Solve problems with ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and unit conversions, including multi-step rate problems.
standards.ccssText: Use ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units to solve single-step and multi-step problems. (College Board: Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Solve percent problems including percent change, percent of a quantity, and successive percent changes in context.
standards.ccssText: Use percentages to solve problems involving parts of a whole, percent increase and decrease, and repeated percent change. (College Board: Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Percentages)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Interpret distributions using mean, median, mode, range, and standard deviation conceptually; reason about the effect of outliers.
standards.ccssText: Analyze one-variable data using measures of center and spread and compare distributions, including the effect of outliers on mean and median. (College Board: Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, One-variable data)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Read scatterplots, interpret lines of best fit, and distinguish linear from exponential growth in two-variable data.
standards.ccssText: Analyze two-variable data using scatterplots and fitted models, interpreting slope and intercepts of a line of best fit in context. (College Board: Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Two-variable data: models and scatterplots)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Compute probabilities and conditional probabilities, especially from two-way tables and real-world data sets.
standards.ccssText: Use probability and conditional probability to reason about events, including reading joint and marginal frequencies from two-way tables. (College Board: Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Probability and conditional probability)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Reason about samples, margin of error, and study design; evaluate which conclusions a statistical study does and does not justify.
standards.ccssText: Use sample statistics and margin of error to draw appropriate inferences, and evaluate statistical claims from observational studies and experiments. (College Board: Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Inference and evaluating statistical claims)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Solve problems involving area, surface area, and volume of common figures, including composite figures and scale effects.
standards.ccssText: Apply area and volume formulas to solve real-world and mathematical problems, including the effect of scaling dimensions. (College Board: Geometry and Trigonometry, Area and volume)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Use angle relationships with parallel lines, triangle angle sums, and similarity and congruence to find missing measures.
standards.ccssText: Use properties of lines, angles, and triangles, including similarity and congruence, to determine unknown lengths and angle measures. (College Board: Geometry and Trigonometry, Lines, angles, and triangles)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Apply the Pythagorean theorem, right-triangle trigonometric ratios, and special right triangles to solve problems.
standards.ccssText: Solve problems using the Pythagorean theorem, sine, cosine, and tangent ratios, and 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangle relationships. (College Board: Geometry and Trigonometry, Right triangles and trigonometry)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Work with circle equations in the coordinate plane, arc length, sector area, and central and inscribed angles.
standards.ccssText: Use the equation of a circle and relationships among radii, chords, arcs, sectors, and angles to solve problems. (College Board: Geometry and Trigonometry, Circles)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.
